title: 注意力感知路由：在MoE中耦合路由与注意力机制
summary: 该研究提出注意力感知路由（AAR），利用注意力权重滑动窗口提取的时序与频谱特征增强MoE路由器，在冻结基础Transformer的情况下仅训练路由参数。AAR在OLMoE上使GSM8K提升3.37个百分点，并揭示路由与注意力形成耦合回路，且具有深度敏感性，暴露了检索与推理之间的张力。
summary_en: This paper proposes Attention-Aware Routing (AAR), which augments the MoE router with temporal and spectral features from a sliding window of attention weights, training only routing parameters while keeping the base transformer frozen. AAR improves GSM8K by +3.37 pp on OLMoE and reveals a coupled routing-attention circuit with strong depth sensitivity, exposing a retrieval-reasoning tension.
